title: Easy Chicken and Vegetable Pot Pie
description: Plenty of vegetables and chicken goes into this simple pot pie filling. Serve with baked pieces of pie crust, puff pastry, crescent rolls, or biscuits.
ingredients: 2 large stalks celery, halved lengthwise and sliced
1.5 cups Almond Breeze Original Unsweetened almondmilk
Meat from 1 rotisserie chicken, skin and bones removed

steps.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and saute for 5 minutes. Add potatoes, celery, and carrots and saute until vegetables are lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Slowly stir in Almond Breeze almondmilk, broth, and seasonings. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture starts to thicken. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add corn and chicken to pan and cook, covered, until heated through, about 5 minutes. Season with pepper.
